text:
As Novartis A G (NVS) Stock Rose, Osterweis Capital Management INC Decreased Its Stake by $8.97 Million Posted by Ash 04 pm
Osterweis Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Novartis A G (NVS) by 20.84% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Osterweis Capital Management Inc sold 104,340 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.30% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 396,438 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $34.16 million, down from 500,778 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Osterweis Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Novartis A G for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $192.64 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $0.86 during the last trading session, reaching $82.49. About 719,255 shares traded. Novartis AG (NYSE:NVS) has risen 4.85% since December 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.85% the S&P500.
Osterweis Capital Management Inc, which manages about $1.62B and $1.57 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Charter Communications Inc N by 12,039 shares to 87,027 shares, valued at $28.36 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Univar Inc by 351,345 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.11 million shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await Novartis AG (NYSE:NVS) to report earnings on January, 23. They expect $1.31 earnings per share, up 9.17 % or $0.11 from last year’s $1.2 per share. NVS’s profit will be $3.06 billion for 15.74 P/E if the $1.31 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.31 actual earnings per share reported by Novartis AG for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 0.00 % EPS growth.
